resource.description: Experimental Linux Studio AAC import/export bridge. Replaces the deprecated FDK encoder; host layouts and AAC profiles have limits.
resource.access: Free source; GPL-2.0-only; dependency licenses separate
resource.platformNotes: Linux x86-64 Resolve Studio. Provider build labels are not converted into a supported Resolve version range. GPU/video codec support is unchanged.

requirements.dependencies: Resolve Studio; source builds need Python 3.8+, a Linux Podman/Docker engine, internet and the Resolve codec SDK.
requirements.installation: Use the original release/build and conflict instructions; the combined package contains decoder and encoder components.

evidence.note: Linux x86-64 Resolve Studio. Provider build labels are not converted into a supported Resolve version range. GPU/video codec support is unchanged.

Experimental AAC import/playback and AAC-LC export bridge for Resolve Studio on Linux x86-64. Uses validated in-memory hooks; unknown layouts stay inactive. The provider reports selected Studio builds, with other profiles, multichannel and sample-accurate delay still needing validation. Replaces the deprecated standalone FDK encoder; not production-qualified native codec support.
Original provider release; not independently installation-tested.
GPL-2.0-only for project code; third-party licenses remain separate.
